newsitem.title: USA: Stock prices rack up second straight day of gains.
newsitem.headline: Stock prices rack up second straight day of gains.

text.p: Stock prices racked up gains for a second session Wednesday as investors rushed back into the market after its recent sell-off.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 38.44 points at 6,346.77, adding to Tuesday's rally of nearly 40 points. In the broader market, advancing issues beat declines 2-1 on active volume of 501 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
